# FixCraft BC

> FixCraft BC is a handyman, painting and small-renovation service for homes, condos and rentals in Metro Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Free written quotes. Contact: fixcraftbc@gmail.com. Website: https://fixcraftbc.ca

Service area: Vancouver, Burnaby, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Richmond, New Westminster and Coquitlam, BC.

Small jobs are welcome; customers often bundle several repairs into one visit. Every job starts with a written quote. Work that needs a licensed electrician or plumber (new circuits, moving plumbing) is flagged up front.

## Services

- [Interior & exterior painting](https://fixcraftbc.ca/painting/): rooms, ceilings, trim, doors, condos, fences, decks, cabinet painting, rental turnovers
- [Door repair & installation](https://fixcraftbc.ca/door-repair/): sticking or squeaky doors, hinges, handles, locks, new interior doors, closet doors, weatherstripping
- [Drywall & wall repair](https://fixcraftbc.ca/drywall-repair/): holes, cracks, nail pops, water damage, texture matching, painting
- [Small kitchen renovations](https://fixcraftbc.ca/kitchen-renovation/): backsplash tile, cabinet painting and hardware, faucets, lighting
- [Bathroom & washroom renovations](https://fixcraftbc.ca/bathroom-renovation/): vanity and toilet replacement, re-caulking, tile repairs, exhaust fans
- [Flooring installation](https://fixcraftbc.ca/flooring/): laminate and luxury vinyl plank, baseboards, transitions, condos and basements
- Handyman repairs and rental / move-out prep: see [home page](https://fixcraftbc.ca/)
